text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew. 
Regarding the wild boar that broke into 
the academy fields, 
I have successfully captured it."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"It is entirely safe now. 
I contacted a gentleman from the local 
hunting association, 
and he came to collect it."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Our quarry was quite formidable this 
time. 
It had a massive build and tremendous 
strength... 
I'm so glad I reinforced the trap 
beforehand!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, and I was told they will prepare the 
boar meat 
into shigureni stew for us later."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"A muscular boar has such firm, lean meat. 
The more you chew, the more its deep, 
savory richness 
will gently spread across your palate."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, let us savor it together, 
Tore-san♪"
